parallelize_model: parallelize a PyTorch model using FSDP sharding, tensor parallelism, and optional activation checkpointing
get_device_mesh: build a CUDA device mesh for data parallel sharding, replication, and tensor parallelism dimensions
setup_torch_distributed: setup torch distributed process group for multi-GPU, multi-node, or SLURM jobs with NCCL backend
check_model_value_range: check a PyTorch model for NaN, Inf, suspicious value ranges, and uninitialized zero parameters
dist_mean: compute the mean of a scalar value across all processes in a distributed device mesh group
